parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the trashcan is made of polypropylene plastic, typically curved and hinged to allow easy opening and closing. It covers the top opening of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: The lid prevents odors from escaping, keeps pests out, and provides a clean appearance. It may include a flap or swing mechanism for hands-free operation.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can rotate or swing open around a hinge or pivot point, allowing access to the interior of the trashcan.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the trashcan is a rectangular container made of polypropylene plastic, designed to hold waste materials.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main storage compartment for trash, supporting the lid and containing the waste bag securely.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is stationary during normal use but can be lifted or moved for emptying or cleaning.
